messages.content: Decide only whether the NEXT action demands a hand or foot that the PREVIOUS action explicitly leaves occupied by a different independent task. Return JSON only. If the text explicitly frees, sets down, pockets, transfers, or repositions the object before the new task, that is NO_CONFLICT. If an occupied limb must perform a different independent task with no explicit freeing/repositioning, return CONFLICT. Ignore all non-limb coherence.
